**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed).

The agreement sits at the **preferred** position for MINCOMMIT:

- **§ 2.1 (p0013)** — "No minimum quantity or purchase commitment applies. Customer pays only for Services ordered in a mutually executed Order Form, and its decision not to enter another Order Form is not a breach or shortfall." This covers both preferred elements expressly, including the anti-shortfall backstop.
- **§ 12.3 (p0051)** — Vendor acknowledges Customer has made no "exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment."
- **§ 7.1 (p0026)** — Vendor may not impose a "minimum-use, or similar charge" not identified in the Order Form.
- **§ 8.2 (p0035)** — Order Forms renew only absent thirty days' non-renewal notice from us, so there is no locked multi-year exposure.
- **§ 22 shortfall references (p0095, p0096)** relate to licence-quantity audit true-ups, not a purchase commitment, so they do not trigger this rule (and are handled as a true-up in any event).
